evidence.note: The retained historical 2013 source route is provisional. Its saved inner contour omits part of the southern return. Matching historical physical edges have not been established; no physical-pavement correction is claimed.

note: Unverified estimate for the historical draft Prodrive source route; the southern inner boundary is incomplete. Calculate only from the supplied boundary geometry after excluding the pinned near-return spike vertices in a disposable footprint. Every original GeoJSON feature, trace, timing, metadata and terrain remains unchanged. The complete 2.05 m vehicle envelope plus 0.5 m clearance must fit that footprint. Reference search is limited to 2 m, lateral optimization to 1 m and final source-station proximity to 3 m; these are optimization trust limits, not measured road widths. No historical edge, physical drivability, surface grip or real lap-time qualification is claimed. The UI must display Unverified source geometry.
